topic: Give AI the right context: a copy-paste prompt template with your code, your rules and the expected behaviour
save_reason: A copy-paste prompt template (code + error, constraints, expected vs actual behaviour), shown on the cheat sheet and in full in the caption.
send_reason: Send this to a friend who says AI gives wrong code.

cover.hook: Give AI this context and get better code.
cover.lineDraft: Learn this prompt format in your first year.

slides.label: Save this
slides.idea: Results first + save promise: the 3-part prompt template (your code, your rules, what should happen).
slides.title: This prompt gets AI to fix the real bug.
slides.line: Copy the 3-part template: code, rules and expected result.
slides.screen: An AI chat input box with three bold headings already typed: Code, Rules, Expected; cursor blinking

slides.label: The problem
slides.idea: 'Fix my code' makes AI guess: it can't see your files, error or rules.
slides.title: AI can't see your project, so it guesses.
slides.line: Just saying 'fix my code' gives it nothing to use.
slides.screen: An AI chat: user message 'fix my code' and a long generic reply that rewrites everything (lines faded)

slides.label: Part 1
slides.idea: Paste the exact code and the full error: only the file that breaks.
slides.title: First, paste the code and the full error.
slides.line: Send only the file that breaks, not the whole project.
slides.screen: Chat message with a short JS code block (fictional cart.js) and a red error 'TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading "price")'

slides.label: Part 2
slides.idea: Tell it what it must not change: language/version, framework, files to leave alone.
slides.title: Next, tell it what it must not change.
slides.line: Name your language, framework and files to leave alone.
slides.screen: Chat message lines: 'Rules: Node 20, Express. Don't change routes.js. Keep my variable names.' with the Rules line highlighted

slides.label: Part 3
slides.idea: Say what should happen instead: the input, the expected result, what you got.
slides.title: This won't work unless you say what should happen.
slides.line: Give the expected result and what you got instead.
slides.screen: Chat message: 'Expected: adding 2 items shows total 498. What happens: total shows NaN.' then AI reply starting 'The cause:' (fictional)

slides.label: Screenshot this
slides.idea: Cheat sheet: the full template, ready to paste.
slides.title: Copy this whole template into your notes.
slides.line: Fill in the blanks each time you ask AI.
slides.screen: A code/notes block 'prompt-template.txt' with the template lines (Code / Error / Rules / Expected / What happens / Explain the cause first)
slides.copy_text:
Here is my code:
<paste only the file that breaks>

Here is the full error:
<paste the error>

Rules: I use <language + version, framework>. Don't change <files or functions>. Keep my variable names.

Expected: when I <input or action>, it should <expected result>.
What happens: <actual result>.

Explain the cause first, then give the smallest fix.

images.prompt: Photoreal location photograph, magazine-ad quality, subtle film grain. A vast old archive hall with towering wooden shelves fading into darkness; one long wooden table in the lower part of the frame where a single brass desk lamp lights a neat stack: a closed folder, a rolled map tied with string and a brass ruler. The top 35% of the frame is the dim, calm upper hall. Portrait 2:3, natural colours. No readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no faces, no watermark.
